task_order: task index modulo 48, exactly 24 full passes per agent; alternate A and B batches at each offset

sizing.rule: choose a multiple of 48 with sqrt(9*ln(40)/n) <= assumed_gap/2
sizing.power_bound: one-sided Hoeffding probability of failing positive separation at the assumed gap is at most exp(-n*(assumed_gap-sqrt(9*ln(40)/n))**2/9); no observed results used in sizing

estimator: per axis: mean(released bucket) - 1; first axis estimates pass rate on this fixed task corpus
interval: two-sided conservative Hoeffding 95%; per-agent radius sqrt(9*ln(40)/(2*n)); difference radius sqrt(9*ln(40)*(1/n_A+1/n_B)/2); untruncated
target_population: the same fixed 48-task fixture corpus, not unseen tasks or learned agents; repeated admissions reduce release-noise uncertainty
noise_sampling: fresh OS randomness in the shipped release kernel, independent per admitted record
canary_sampling: fresh balanced SystemRandom-shuffled honest cohorts; private schedules never persisted
budget_extension: Copy the retained first-run SQLite budget into a fresh evidence directory and extend its cap from 352 to 2656 before access. Preserve used=352. The original ledger is never modified. This publicly predeclared extra allowance does not reset privacy accounting.
reporting: One utility-only cohort. Preserve all attempts and failures. Keep the first run and its original utility interval in the receipt. Report the observed interval even if it includes zero. No attack rerun or pooling with the first utility sample.
